safety.title: Trust & Safety
safety.intro: Your safety matters. Follow these rules when looking for online work.
safety.s1: Never pay a fee to get a job, a test or a contract. Legitimate opportunities do not ask for money upfront.
safety.s2: Be careful with offers that promise guaranteed income or very high pay for little work.
safety.s3: Keep conversations and payments traceable. Do not share passwords or verification codes.
safety.s4: Check the client's profile and website before accepting a project.
safety.s5: Report any suspicious opportunity using the report button on its page.
